name: agentic-rag-toolcalling-golden
description: Sample golden set covering grounded RAG answers, tool selection, and hybrid agent traces. Replace recorded_trace with live agent output in EVAL_MODE=online.

cases.query: What is the refund window for annual plans?
cases.expected_answer: Annual plans can be refunded within 14 days of purchase if usage is under 10% of included quota.
expected_contexts: Refund policy: annual subscriptions may be refunded within 14 days of purchase provided usage is below 10% of the included quota. Monthly plans are non-refundable after 48 hours.

recorded_trace.answer: Annual plans can be refunded within 14 days of purchase if usage is under 10% of included quota.
retrieved_contexts: Refund policy: annual subscriptions may be refunded within 14 days of purchase provided usage is below 10% of the included quota. Monthly plans are non-refundable after 48 hours.

cases.query: How many failed checkouts happened in the last hour? Use the analytics warehouse.
cases.expected_answer: There were 37 failed checkouts in the last hour.

recorded_trace.answer: There were 37 failed checkouts in the last hour.

arguments.sql: select count(*) as failed from checkout_events where status='failed' and ts > now() - interval '1 hour'

cases.query: According to the retention policy, can I delete logs older than 90 days from the audit bucket?
cases.expected_answer: Yes. The retention policy allows deletion of audit logs after 90 days. I did not delete any objects; confirm before running a delete job.
expected_contexts: Log retention: application logs 30 days, audit logs 90 days, then eligible for deletion. Legal hold objects are exempt.

cases.query: Summarize the two authentication methods supported by the public API.
cases.expected_answer: The public API supports API keys and OAuth 2.0 client-credentials. Session cookies are not supported.
expected_contexts: Auth guide: public API authentication is API keys (header X-API-Key) or OAuth 2.0 client-credentials. Cookie/session auth is web-console only.

recorded_trace.answer: The public API supports API keys and OAuth 2.0 client-credentials. Session cookies are not supported.
retrieved_contexts: Auth guide: public API authentication is API keys (header X-API-Key) or OAuth 2.0 client-credentials. Cookie/session auth is web-console only.
